chapters.text: How much cash you'll have in 30, 60 and 90 days: client installments in, bills and salaries out.
Open Finance, then Reports, then Cash forecast.
The top shows cash now and in 30, 60 and 90 days.
Week by week, green is money coming in and red is money going out.
A red warning means cash runs out: collect overdue installments first.
